drums.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid, palm-muted downstrokes and power chord transitions. Overdriven bass guitar follows the guitar root notes with a pick. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with constant eighth-note hi-hat hits and a prominent, dry snare. Male vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery. 180 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of E Minor. The guitar tone is mid-heavy with high gain, while the bass has a clanky, metallic high-end. The vocal performance is rhythmic and percussive, sitting forward in the mix with minimal reverb.

bass.tags: Indie rock with a driving, rhythmic focus. The arrangement features a clean electric guitar playing a repetitive, syncopated two-note riff and a prominent electric bass that follows the kick drum pattern. The drum kit consists of a tight snare, a dry kick, and consistent eighth-note hi-hats. A subtle, sustained organ pad provides harmonic filling in the background. The tempo is 124 BPM in 4/4 time. The track is in the key of A major. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the interlocking rhythmic parts.
